title: Recurring vendor charges against contract terms
prompt: Each month, compare recurring vendor charges with contract terms and prior periods. Flag rate changes, duplicate invoices and unexpected fees.
steps: read the standing contract register (rates, escalators, start and end dates)
pull the month's vendor charges and the prior months
run recurrence_detect, then schedule_vs_actual against the register
flag rate changes outside the escalator, duplicate invoices and fees not in the contract; list vendors with no contract

done.text: Every exception row cites the vendor id, the invoice id and the contract line
vendor-contract-exceptions.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Contractual escalators and usage-based changes are allowed; vendors with no contract on the register are listed separately
